findings: Compound heterozygous LDLR mutations: c.763T>C (p.Cys255Arg): PM1+PM2+PP3+PP4 (Likely Pathogenic)
rationale: The compound heterozygous mutations were identified and classified per ACMG standards, with one being likely pathogenic and the other a VUS, supporting a damaging effect on the LDLR gene product.
